redis.ParentIndex.answers: which workflows are projected at all
redis.ParentIndex.never_for: the set of workflows that exist — that is Postgres

redis.Root.answers: whether one workflow is projected right now
redis.Root.never_for: the workflow's definition — L2 is a projection and legitimately lags a PUT until the next start

redis.Step.answers: the projected shape of one step inside a running workflow
redis.Step.never_for: the step's edges — those live in the StepNextSteps junction

redis.PerInstance.answers: one replica's liveness, with its status and interval
redis.PerInstance.never_for: deciding a replica is gone — stale at 2x the interval but present until 4x, so absent and unhealthy are different answers

redis.InstanceIndex.answers: how many replicas of a processor have ever registered
redis.InstanceIndex.never_for: a live replica count — membership outlives a dead replica's entry key

redis.ExecutionData.answers: whether a step's output blob landed under its entry id
redis.ExecutionData.never_for: throughput — these keys carry no TTL, so a lingering blob is a leak to report, not garbage awaiting collection
